description: Source code implementing thread pool and waitable event classes for ANGLE project, including single-threaded and asynchronous worker pools with synchronization primitives.

classes.name: WaitableEvent
classes.description: Base class for waitable synchronization events.

classes.name: WaitableEventDone
classes.description: Derived class representing a completed event.

classes.name: SingleThreadedWorkerPool
classes.description: Worker pool implementation for single-threaded execution.

classes.name: AsyncWaitableEvent
classes.description: Waitable event for asynchronous execution, using futures and condition variables.

classes.name: AsyncWorkerPool
classes.description: Worker pool implementation for multi-threaded asynchronous execution.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Method to wait for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the event is ready.

methods.name: postWorkerTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the worker pool for execution.

methods.name: setMaxThreads
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of worker threads.

methods.name: isAsync
methods.description: Returns whether the worker pool is asynchronous.

methods.name: checkToRunPendingTasks
methods.description: Checks and runs pending tasks in the async worker pool.
